disclaimer: Deterministic portfolio composition demonstration. It does not claim an integrated production runtime.

journeys.title: Enterprise procurement agent

source.title: Procurement objective
source.copy: Define business intent, owner, supplier-data boundaries and acceptable autonomy before an agent exists.

journeys.axonCopy: Use typed agent, tool and flow declarations to make the intended workflow inspectable before runtime.
journeys.meshCopy: Route the declared agent through suitability, risk, policy, approval, sandbox and evidence gates.

output.title: Governed operator flow
output.copy: Present decisions, approvals and evidence as a clear operational journey rather than a hidden agent response.

journeys.summary: Intent → typed agent structure → deterministic governance → operator-facing experience.

journeys.title: MSME compliance copilot

source.title: Practical business problem
source.copy: Start from an India-first compliance or operating task and define what must remain human-controlled.

journeys.axonCopy: Represent tool access, data inputs and workflow steps explicitly so a future copilot is reviewable by construction.
journeys.meshCopy: Apply deterministic policy, approval and audit boundaries before any sensitive business action is considered.

output.title: Low-friction business UI
output.copy: Translate governed capability into a small, understandable workflow suitable for constrained devices and busy operators.

journeys.summary: MSME need → explicit workflow → governance boundary → practical lightweight experience.

journeys.title: STEM tutor

source.title: Learning objective
source.copy: Begin with a curiosity-led learning goal, age context and the boundaries of what the tutor should explain or do.

journeys.axonCopy: Describe tutoring agents, learning tools and orchestration explicitly instead of hiding the learning flow in prompts.
journeys.meshCopy: Model policy, tool scope, approval and evidence for a safer learning-agent pathway before production integration.

output.title: Explorable lesson world
output.copy: Turn the governed learning flow into an interactive visual experience where questions, experiments and explanations connect.

journeys.summary: Learning goal → structured tutor workflow → safety/governance boundary → explorable lesson world.
